Cloudflare OS: An AI productivity environment

Cloudflare OS is an "operating system" for AI productivity originally developed for use inside Cloudflare. A large portion of Cloudflare's workforce -- from engineering to sales and everything in between -- uses Cloudflare OS every day to help them do their jobs.

This is not a traditional computer operating system. We use the term "operating system" in two senses:

  • An operating system for the company to be productive with AI, in a way that is safe, so that the security team can sleep at night.
  • An operating system for AI workloads, analogous to the sense in which a traditional operating system manages compute workloads.

Cloudflare OS provides three things in particular:

  1. An agent chat UI where you can ask agents to do tasks, preloaded with knowledge about how your company operates.
  2. Sandboxed application development, so that you can ask agents to build "gadgets" (small personal apps) and safely share what you've built with others.
  3. A security framework, called Gatekeepers, that applies guardrails to both agents and apps such that non-technical users can safely "go nuts" and nothing bad will happen.

We are making Cloudflare OS open source so that others can copy it and customize it for their own company. The idea is not that your company uses Cloudflare OS, but rather that you make it "Your Company OS".

Quick Start

To quickly run Cloudflare OS locally, install pnpm, then do:

pnpm run-local

Then visit: http://localhost:8787

This runs the whole stack locally on wrangler and workerd. This is not meant for production use, but is a quick way to see what the product does.

Alternatively, you can deploy to your Cloudflare account.

(More options at the end of this readme.)

What to try

Try prompts like:

  • "Make slides for my upcoming meeting with a customer." (This will use the built-in slides blueprint.)
  • "Make a collaborative whiteboard app." (This will create a new app from scratch.)
  • "Make a tic tac toe game." followed by "I'll be X and you be O. I've made my first move. Your turn."
  • "Make an issue dashboard for this GitHub repo." (Attach a repo; requires that the GitHub integration is configured.)
  • "Fix the typos in this Google Doc." (Attach a doc; requires that the Google integration is configured.)

WARNING: Early access

Cloudflare OS is in a state of heavy development. This repository is actually version 2, a complete rewrite taking what we learned from version 1 and putting it on a new foundation.

As of the August 2026 release, Cloudflare OS v2 is very capable, but still has many rough edges. We know, and we're working on it. For now, consider this an "early access" release.

Overview: What is Cloudflare OS really?

Gadgets: A new way of thinking about software

Cloudflare OS is more than just another chatbox with connectors. The system revolves around a new approach to software, where every user runs their own copy of the productivity apps they use.

When you create a slide deck in Cloudflare OS, you are not calling out to some SaaS software running in the cloud. The system creates a private instance of the slide deck software just for you. We call this a "gadget". This instance runs in a separate sandbox from everyone else's slide decks.

This has two profound effects:

  1. It's impossible for the slide deck app to have a security bug that leaks your slides to an attacker. The Cloudflare OS sandbox controls all access to your private instance of the app.
  2. If you want, you can freely modify the code. If the slide deck app is missing a feature you need, you can just ask your agent to add it. And because of point 1, it's totally safe to do so.

This is a big departure from the last 25 years of cloud architecture and "Software as a Service", but we think AI has changed the equation. When any user is capable of prompting an agent to add the features they need, the centralized model of software stops making sense.

Gatekeepers: A capability-based security layer

Gatekeepers are like supercharged MCP servers.

When you introduce an agent or Gadget to an external resource, a Gatekeeper is created to manage that access. The Gatekeeper is a piece of software specific to each external service which moderates a Gadget's connection to that service. It:

  • Provides a clean Cap'n Web API to the service (wrapping whatever API the service provides natively).
  • Handles authorization (e.g. via OAuth).
  • Enforces narrow access to only the specific resource the user intended.
  • Logs every action the Gadget (or agent) performs, for your review.
  • For any action which has side effects, provides the human user an opportunity to approve or deny the action ("human in the loop").

On the last point, Gatekeepers implement a significant advancement in the state of the art. Traditionally, human-in-the-loop setups require the human to approve actions synchronously. When the agent wants to do something, it has to stop and wait for said approval before it can continue. This is annoying: you give your agent a task, then walk away and get a coffee, only to come back and find the agent got stuck on an approval on the first step and has made no progress. As a result, people often give in and set their agents to "auto-approve", or --dangerously-skip-permissions, which is, obviously, unsafe.

Gatekeepers provide a better way: When the agent (or Gadget) performs an action that requires approval, the Gatekeeper will simulate the outcome locally, allowing the agent to proceed and queue up more actions. The Gatekeeper tells the agent that the action completed, and if the agent tries to read back the results, the Gatekeeper gives it simulated results. Once the agent is done, the user may approve or reject the actions in bulk, or one-by-one, but either way, they can do it later, when it is convenient.

Logistically, each Gatekeeper is implemented as a separate Worker. In the future, we envision Gatekeeper services being deployed and maintained independently from OS instances, but the details have yet to be worked out. For now, we have provided a few interesting Gatekeepers in this repository which you can deploy together with your own OS instance.

Think of an office suite

The basic user experience of Cloudflare OS is something like an online office suite, like Google Docs or MS Office. But, imagine that instead of a fixed set of file types (document, spreadsheet, slide deck), each file -- or "Gadget" -- is potentially its own custom application, written by AI to serve exactly your needs.

Just like office docs, each gadget is private by default, but can be shared -- securely -- in order to collaborate with your team or your friends.

Just like office docs, you can have thousands of them. You can create them on a whim.

Just like office docs, you can start from "templates" -- called "Blueprints". But where an office template is just some content, a Blueprint specifies a whole application.

Like office docs, you can create new templates (blueprints) from your own docs (Gadgets) and share them with others. But when you do so, you are sharing the code for a whole app.

It kind of is an Operating System

The OS terminology isn't entirely marketing. Cloudflare OS is actually analogous to an operating system on a technical level.

Normal OS Cloudflare OS
kernel packages/workshop-backend
device drivers packages/gatekeeper-*
shell packages/workshop-frontend
processes gadgets
executables blueprints
users users
ACLs shared permissions
??? agents

Our "kernel" is in the workshop-backend package. The backend legitimately does a lot of things similar to real OS kernels: it connects users to programs and devices (Gadgets and Gatekeepers, as we call them) while implementing security by sandboxing applications and enforcing access control.

In this analogy, Gatekeepers -- which connect users and agents to external services -- are like drivers -- which connect users and programs to external devices.

There is one thing that traditional OSes don't really manage today, but Cloudflare OS does: AI agents. If you think about it, this is really a missing feature in traditional OSes. We believe that AI agents cannot simply be treated as users. They must be accountable to a human user, while at the same time having their own restricted permissions. Agents do work by writing snippets of code and executing them on the fly. The ideal security model for all of this is capability-based security, not access control lists. See what I mean? Perhaps traditional OSes ought to give AI agents special treatment, too.

Built on Workers, by the Workers team

Cloudflare OS is built on Cloudflare Workers, making heavy use of Durable Objects, Dynamic Workers, and Facets in particular. Every workspace is its own Durable Object, every Gadget runs in a Dynamic Worker Facet, and Gatekeepers also install facets into each workspace to manage access to remote services.

Cloudflare OS is, in fact, built by the very people who built Workers itself. It uses cutting-edge features of the Workers Runtime -- in fact, Dynamic Workers, Facets, and several other features were added to the runtime specifically to support Cloudflare OS, with more to come. Studying the Cloudflare OS source code is a great way to understand how the Workers Runtime team thinks Workers should be used.

Being built on Workers does not mean that Cloudflare OS can only run on Cloudflare. In fact, workerd, the Cloudflare Workers Runtime, is itself open source, and Cloudflare OS can run entirely on top of it on your own servers.

Features

General multi-purpose agent

The Cloudflare OS coding agent is actually a fully multi-purpose agent that can perform arbitrary tasks; like other popular coding agents, you don't have to code with it. You can use it to build Gadgets, but you can also skip the Gadget and just have the agent perform tasks directly. The Cloudflare OS agent is a Code Mode agent -- it performs tasks by writing and immediately executing snippets of code. It can be connected to external resources using Gatekeepers (like MCP -- see below).

Build apps with AI

While you can code a Gadget by hand if you want, the expectation is that AI writes the code for you. Cloudflare OS features a built-in coding agent that will build whatever you ask it, test it for you, and debug errors.

You can choose your LLM. Cloudflare OS works with many major AI model providers and self-hosted models, with more providers being added all the time.

Because of the tightly-integrated and simplified nature of the platform, even when using the same underlying AI models, the Cloudflare OS coding agent often performs better and faster with fewer tokens than a general-purpose coding agent would.

Collaborate with AI

Every app built with Cloudflare OS automatically has an agent-friendly API. That means, after you've asked AI to build the app, you can also ask AI to collaborate with you inside the app. No need to build an MCP server nor integrate a custom agent loop. It's just there by default.

This works because the client and server portions of a Gadget are required to communicate via Cap'n Web RPC. This is a win-win:

  1. Cap'n Web is extremely low-boilerplate, which makes it easy for agents to work with. You basically just define a method on your server, then call it from your client, as if it were a local call.
  2. Meanwhile, it means that the server necessarily exposes an easy-to-understand API which could be called directly by an agent. The AI Agent harness uses Code Mode for tool calling, making it trivial to expose the Gadget's API directly for the agent to invoke.

Real-time Multiplayer

You can share your Gadget just like you'd share a document in a typical online office suite. You can give specific users access, or create a share link that provides access to anyone who opens it. And just like those online office suites, you'll be able to see your collaborators' actions in real time.

This works because every Gadget is backed by a Durable Object, Cloudflare's stateful serverless primitive which makes real-time multiplayer collaboration easy. It's so easy that the coding agent just implements it by default, without being asked.

Blueprints: Share your code

If you've created a Gadget that might be useful to others, but you don't want to share the Gadget itself, you can instead share a Blueprint, allowing other people to create their own copy of the Gadget. A Blueprint is essentially a copy of the code.

It may sound simple, but Blueprints are a major change from cloud software tradition. Traditionally, if you create a web app that you want to share with other users, you host the app on your server, and the users connect to that. Blueprints are much more like mobile apps and traditional PC apps: every user runs their own copy of the software.

In the age of AI, this change is critically important. On one hand, AI empowers an individual developer to build more than ever, but it is still difficult for an individual developer to maintain an online service; this eliminates the need. On the other hand -- and even more importantly -- allowing each user to run their own copy of the software empowers the user to change the software to meet their needs, using AI. No need to file a feature request, no need to beg the developer to prioritize it. The end user can solve their own problems.

Sandboxed and secure by default

Each Gadget runs in a secure sandbox that prevents it from talking to the internet at all without your explicit consent. In particular:

  • The server runs in a Dynamic Worker which has had its access to the internet disabled. It can only communicate with specific external resources that you have explicitly designated, via Workers Bindings.
  • The client code runs in a sandboxed iframe. This iframe can communicate with its server only via a Cap'n Web RPC session provided over postMessage() to the parent frame. The iframe is otherwise blocked from accessing the internet (to the maximum extent allowed by browsers, via Content-Security-Policy and iframe sandbox settings).

Capability-based access control

Each agent, and each Gadget, by default has access to nothing. Even if you've configured the Gadget Workshop with access to external accounts, agents and Gadgets do NOT automatically get to use them.

Instead, you must introduce each agent (or Gadget) to any particular resources you want it to access. For instance, you may introduce a GitHub repository by pasting a link to it, or clicking "add resource" and selecting it via the UI. An agent can also request an introduction to a resource it thinks it needs, which you can then provide or deny.

This differs from most agent harnesses, where MCP servers are configured upfront, making broad access to all your services ambiently available to the agent in every chat. Capability-based introductions keep each agent restricted to only the access it actually needs for the job at hand.

Get Started

Deploy to your Cloudflare account

We've built an online flow that helps you deploy to your own Cloudflare account:

https://os.cloudflare.app/deploy

Or, for more sophisticated deployment, with your gatekeepers and potentially code changes, check out our deployment starter repo:

https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-os-starter

Run locally

To quickly run Cloudflare OS locally, install pnpm, then do:

pnpm run-local

Then visit: http://localhost:8787

This runs Cloudflare OS using wrangler, the Workers developer tooling CLI. This is not the right way to run the OS on a production server, but it works fine for trying it out on your local machine.

Your data will be stored in a subdirectory named .wrangler.

Deploy to your own server using workerd

COMING SOON

Cloudflare OS can run entirely on workerd, Cloudflare's open source runtime for Workers. In fact, the "run locally" instructions above use workerd under the hood. We are still working on documentation and tooling to help you smoothly deploy the OS on top of workerd on your own servers. If you are feeling adventurous, read the low-level documentation for workerd config (or point your agent at it) and have a go.

Configuring external services

Many Gatekeepers require configuration in order to be able to connect to third-party services, including obtaining OAuth client credentials for each service. Unfortunately, many service providers intentionally do not make this easy, since the intended audience for OAuth is developers.

Each gatekeeper package contains instructions for how to set it up:

  • GitHub API
  • Google API
  • Cloudflare API
  • Supabase API
  • Notion API
  • Confluence API
  • Email Workers
  • Home Assistant
  • Slack API
  • Spotify
  • ZoomInfo API

Developing

When developing, you'll want to run the front-end and back-end as two separate commands in two terminals:

pnpm dev-server
pnpm dev-client

Then visit: http://localhost:3000

Contributing

At this time, we are not seeking outside contribution.

AI has made writing code easy. The hard part, today, is not writing the code, but reviewing it, making sure quality stays high, and keeping the product coherent. In that light, unfortunately, external code contributions are "donating" the easy part of the job, while creating more of the hard work.

With that said, we are happy to accept small, trivially-verified PRs that fix a problem. However, we ask that you refrain from submitting low-value PRs (e.g. typo fixes) or PRs that are more than a dozen or so lines. Such PRs will be closed with a reference to this guideline.

If you have a big idea you'd like us to consider, feel free to open a discussion about it.

This policy may change in the future as the project matures. Until then, thank you for your understanding.

Credits

Cloudflare OS has far too many open source dependencies to list here. But, we'd like to highlight a few that do particularly heavy lifting:

  • Pi (specifically, pi-agent-core), which made it easy to support every LLM provider with one API.
  • Monaco which makes it too easy to embed a beautiful text editor -- for those of us who still look at the code.
  • Yjs, which we use extensively to sync code changes between clients and agents and replay histories.
  • Vite, which makes the development loop so pleasant.

Each gatekeeper package contains instructions for how to set it up: GitHub API Google API Cloudflare API Supabase API Notion API Confluence API Email Workers Home Assistant Slack API Spotify ZoomInfo API Developing When developing, you'll want to run the front-end and back-end as two separate commands in two terminals: pnpm dev-server pnpm dev-client Then visit: http://localhost:3000 Contributing At this time, we are not seeking outside contribution. AI has made writing code easy. The hard part, today, is not writing the code, but reviewing it, making sure quality stays high, and keeping the product coherent. In that light, unfortunately, external code contributions are "donating" the easy part of the job, while creating more of the hard work. With that said, we are happy to accept small, trivially-verified PRs that fix a problem. However, we ask that you refrain from submitting low-value PRs (e.g. typo fixes) or PRs that are more than a dozen or so lines. Such PRs will be closed with a reference to this guideline. If you have a big idea you'd like us to consider, feel free to open a discussion about it. This policy may change in the future as the project matures. Until then, thank you for your understanding. Credits Cloudflare OS has far too many open source dependencies to list here. But, we'd like to highlight a few that do particularly heavy lifting: Pi (specifically, pi-agent-core), which made it easy to support every LLM provider with one API. Monaco which makes it too easy to embed a beautiful text editor -- for those of us who still look at the code. Yjs, which we use extensively to sync code changes between clients and agents and replay histories. Vite, which makes the development loop so pleasant.

blocks.html_en: Our "kernel" is in the workshop-backend package. The backend legitimately does a lot of things similar to real OS kernels: it connects users to programs and devices (Gadgets and Gatekeepers, as we call them) while implementing security by sandboxing applications and enforcing access control.

sentences.en: Our "kernel" is in the workshop-backend package.
sentences.zh: 我们的“内核”位于 Workshop-backend 包中。

sentences.en: The backend legitimately does a lot of things similar to real OS kernels: it connects users to programs and devices (Gadgets and Gatekeepers, as we call them) while implementing security by sandboxing applications and enforcing access control.
sentences.zh: 后端合法地执行许多类似于真实操作系统内核的操作：它将用户连接到程序和设备（我们称之为小工具和网守），同时通过沙箱应用程序和实施访问控制来实现安全性。

blocks.html_en: In this analogy, Gatekeepers -- which connect users and agents to external services -- are like drivers -- which connect users and programs to external devices.

sentences.en: In this analogy, Gatekeepers -- which connect users and agents to external services -- are like drivers -- which connect users and programs to external devices.
sentences.zh: 在这个类比中，网守（将用户和代理连接到外部服务）就像驱动程序（将用户和程序连接到外部设备）。

blocks.html_en: There is one thing that traditional OSes don't really manage today, but Cloudflare OS does: AI agents. If you think about it, this is really a missing feature in traditional OSes. We believe that AI agents cannot simply be treated as users. They must be accountable to a human user, while at the same time having their own restricted permissions. Agents do work by writing snippets of code and executing them on the fly. The ideal security model for all of this is capability-based security, not access control lists. See what I mean? Perhaps traditional OSes ought to give AI agents special treatment, too.

sentences.en: There is one thing that traditional OSes don't really manage today, but Cloudflare OS does: AI agents.
sentences.zh: 如今，传统操作系统无法真正管理一件事，但 Cloudflare OS 可以管理：AI 代理。

sentences.en: If you think about it, this is really a missing feature in traditional OSes.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，这确实是传统操作系统所缺少的功能。

sentences.en: We believe that AI agents cannot simply be treated as users.
sentences.zh: 我们认为人工智能代理不能简单地被视为用户。

sentences.en: They must be accountable to a human user, while at the same time having their own restricted permissions.
sentences.zh: 他们必须对人类用户负责，同时拥有自己的受限权限。

sentences.en: Agents do work by writing snippets of code and executing them on the fly.
sentences.zh: 代理通过编写代码片段并即时执行来工作。

sentences.en: The ideal security model for all of this is capability-based security, not access control lists.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切的理想安全模型是基于功能的安全性，而不是访问控制列表。

sentences.en: See what I mean?
sentences.zh: 明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Perhaps traditional OSes ought to give AI agents special treatment, too.
sentences.zh: 也许传统操作系统也应该给予人工智能代理特殊待遇。

blocks.html_en: Built on Workers, by the Workers team

sentences.en: Built on Workers, by the Workers team
sentences.zh: 由 Workers 团队以 Workers 为基础构建

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare OS is built on Cloudflare Workers, making heavy use of Durable Objects, Dynamic Workers, and Facets in particular. Every workspace is its own Durable Object, every Gadget runs in a Dynamic Worker Facet, and Gatekeepers also install facets into each workspace to manage access to remote services.

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS is built on Cloudflare Workers, making heavy use of Durable Objects, Dynamic Workers, and Facets in particular.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare OS 构建于 Cloudflare Workers 之上，特别大量使用了 Durable Objects、Dynamic Workers 和 Facets。

sentences.en: Every workspace is its own Durable Object, every Gadget runs in a Dynamic Worker Facet, and Gatekeepers also install facets into each workspace to manage access to remote services.
sentences.zh: 每个工作区都是其自己的持久对象，每个小工具都在动态工作人员方面运行，并且网守还将方面安装到每个工作区中以管理对远程服务的访问。

blocks.html_en: Cloudflare OS is, in fact, built by the very people who built Workers itself. It uses cutting-edge features of the Workers Runtime -- in fact, Dynamic Workers, Facets, and several other features were added to the runtime specifically to support Cloudflare OS, with more to come. Studying the Cloudflare OS source code is a great way to understand how the Workers Runtime team thinks Workers should be used.

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS is, in fact, built by the very people who built Workers itself.
sentences.zh: 事实上，Cloudflare OS 是由构建 Workers 的人构建的。

sentences.en: It uses cutting-edge features of the Workers Runtime -- in fact, Dynamic Workers, Facets, and several other features were added to the runtime specifically to support Cloudflare OS, with more to come.
sentences.zh: 它使用了 Workers Runtime 的尖端功能——事实上，动态 Workers、Facets 和其他几个功能都被添加到运行时中，专门用于支持 Cloudflare OS，而且还会有更多功能。

sentences.en: Studying the Cloudflare OS source code is a great way to understand how the Workers Runtime team thinks Workers should be used.
sentences.zh: 研究 Cloudflare OS 源代码是了解 Workers Runtime 团队认为应如何使用 Workers 的好方法。

blocks.html_en: Being built on Workers does not mean that Cloudflare OS can only run on Cloudflare. In fact, workerd, the Cloudflare Workers Runtime, is itself open source, and Cloudflare OS can run entirely on top of it on your own servers.

sentences.en: Being built on Workers does not mean that Cloudflare OS can only run on Cloudflare.
sentences.zh: 基于 Workers 构建并不意味着 Cloudflare OS 只能在 Cloudflare 上运行。

sentences.en: In fact, workerd, the Cloudflare Workers Runtime, is itself open source, and Cloudflare OS can run entirely on top of it on your own servers.
sentences.zh: 事实上，workerd（Cloudflare Workers Runtime）本身就是开源的，Cloudflare OS 可以完全在您自己的服务器上运行。

blocks.html_en: General multi-purpose agent

sentences.en: General multi-purpose agent

blocks.html_en: The Cloudflare OS coding agent is actually a fully multi-purpose agent that can perform arbitrary tasks; like other popular coding agents, you don't have to code with it. You can use it to build Gadgets, but you can also skip the Gadget and just have the agent perform tasks directly. The Cloudflare OS agent is a Code Mode agent -- it performs tasks by writing and immediately executing snippets of code. It can be connected to external resources using Gatekeepers (like MCP -- see below).

sentences.en: The Cloudflare OS coding agent is actually a fully multi-purpose agent that can perform arbitrary tasks; like other popular coding agents, you don't have to code with it.

sentences.en: You can use it to build Gadgets, but you can also skip the Gadget and just have the agent perform tasks directly.
sentences.zh: 您可以使用它来构建 Gadget，但您也可以跳过 Gadget，直接让代理执行任务。

blocks.html_en: While you can code a Gadget by hand if you want, the expectation is that AI writes the code for you. Cloudflare OS features a built-in coding agent that will build whatever you ask it, test it for you, and debug errors.

sentences.en: While you can code a Gadget by hand if you want, the expectation is that AI writes the code for you.
sentences.zh: 虽然您可以根据需要手动编写小工具代码，但我们期望 AI 为您编写代码。

sentences.en: Cloudflare OS features a built-in coding agent that will build whatever you ask it, test it for you, and debug errors.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare OS 具有内置编码代理，可以构建您要求的任何内容、为您测试并调试错误。

blocks.html_en: You can choose your LLM. Cloudflare OS works with many major AI model providers and self-hosted models, with more providers being added all the time.

sentences.en: You can choose your LLM.

blocks.html_en: Because of the tightly-integrated and simplified nature of the platform, even when using the same underlying AI models, the Cloudflare OS coding agent often performs better and faster with fewer tokens than a general-purpose coding agent would.

sentences.en: Because of the tightly-integrated and simplified nature of the platform, even when using the same underlying AI models, the Cloudflare OS coding agent often performs better and faster with fewer tokens than a general-purpose coding agent would.
sentences.zh: 由于平台的紧密集成和简化特性，即使使用相同的底层 AI 模型，Cloudflare OS 编码代理通常也能比通用编码代理以更少的令牌执行更好、更快的性能。

blocks.html_en: Collaborate with AI

sentences.en: Collaborate with AI

blocks.html_en: Every app built with Cloudflare OS automatically has an agent-friendly API. That means, after you've asked AI to build the app, you can also ask AI to collaborate with you inside the app. No need to build an MCP server nor integrate a custom agent loop. It's just there by default.

sentences.en: Every app built with Cloudflare OS automatically has an agent-friendly API.
sentences.zh: 每个使用 Cloudflare OS 构建的应用程序都会自动具有代理友好的 API。

sentences.en: That means, after you've asked AI to build the app, you can also ask AI to collaborate with you inside the app.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，在您要求 AI 构建应用程序后，您还可以要求 AI 在应用程序内与您协作。

sentences.en: No need to build an MCP server nor integrate a custom agent loop.
sentences.zh: 无需构建 MCP 服务器，也无需集成自定义代理循环。

sentences.en: It's just there by default.
sentences.zh: 它只是默认存在。

blocks.html_en: This works because the client and server portions of a Gadget are required to communicate via Cap'n Web RPC. This is a win-win:

sentences.en: This works because the client and server portions of a Gadget are required to communicate via Cap'n Web RPC.
sentences.zh: 这是可行的，因为 Gadget 的客户端和服务器部分需要通过 Cap'n Web RPC 进行通信。

sentences.en: This is a win-win:
sentences.zh: 这是双赢的：

blocks.html_en: • Cap'n Web is extremely low-boilerplate, which makes it easy for agents to work with. You basically just define a method on your server, then call it from your client, as if it were a local call.

sentences.en: Cap'n Web is extremely low-boilerplate, which makes it easy for agents to work with.
sentences.zh: Cap'n Web 的样板代码极少，这使得代理可以轻松使用。

sentences.en: You basically just define a method on your server, then call it from your client, as if it were a local call.
sentences.zh: 您基本上只需在服务器上定义一个方法，然后从客户端调用它，就像本地调用一样。

blocks.html_en: • Meanwhile, it means that the server necessarily exposes an easy-to-understand API which could be called directly by an agent. The AI Agent harness uses Code Mode for tool calling, making it trivial to expose the Gadget's API directly for the agent to invoke.

sentences.en: Meanwhile, it means that the server necessarily exposes an easy-to-understand API which could be called directly by an agent.
sentences.zh: 同时，这意味着服务器必须公开一个易于理解的API，可以由代理直接调用。

sentences.en: The AI Agent harness uses Code Mode for tool calling, making it trivial to expose the Gadget's API directly for the agent to invoke.
sentences.zh: AI Agent 工具使用代码模式进行工具调用，因此可以轻松直接公开 Gadget 的 API 以供代理调用。

blocks.html_en: You can share your Gadget just like you'd share a document in a typical online office suite. You can give specific users access, or create a share link that provides access to anyone who opens it. And just like those online office suites, you'll be able to see your collaborators' actions in real time.

sentences.en: You can share your Gadget just like you'd share a document in a typical online office suite.
sentences.zh: 您可以共享您的小工具，就像在典型的在线办公套件中共享文档一样。

sentences.en: You can give specific users access, or create a share link that provides access to anyone who opens it.
sentences.zh: 您可以授予特定用户访问权限，或创建共享链接，为打开该链接的任何人提供访问权限。

sentences.en: And just like those online office suites, you'll be able to see your collaborators' actions in real time.
sentences.zh: 就像那些在线办公套件一样，您将能够实时查看协作者的操作。

blocks.html_en: This works because every Gadget is backed by a Durable Object, Cloudflare's stateful serverless primitive which makes real-time multiplayer collaboration easy. It's so easy that the coding agent just implements it by default, without being asked.

sentences.en: This works because every Gadget is backed by a Durable Object, Cloudflare's stateful serverless primitive which makes real-time multiplayer collaboration easy.
sentences.zh: 这是有效的，因为每个 Gadget 都由持久对象（Durable Object）支持，这是 Cloudflare 的有状态无服务器原语，使实时多人协作变得容易。

sentences.en: It's so easy that the coding agent just implements it by default, without being asked.
sentences.zh: 它非常简单，编码代理只需默认实现即可，无需询问。

sentences.en: Blueprints: Share your code

blocks.html_en: If you've created a Gadget that might be useful to others, but you don't want to share the Gadget itself, you can instead share a Blueprint, allowing other people to create their own copy of the Gadget. A Blueprint is essentially a copy of the code.

sentences.en: If you've created a Gadget that might be useful to others, but you don't want to share the Gadget itself, you can instead share a Blueprint, allowing other people to create their own copy of the Gadget.
sentences.zh: 如果您创建了一个可能对其他人有用的小工具，但您不想共享该小工具本身，则可以共享蓝图，从而允许其他人创建自己的小工具副本。

sentences.en: A Blueprint is essentially a copy of the code.
sentences.zh: 蓝图本质上是代码的副本。

blocks.html_en: It may sound simple, but Blueprints are a major change from cloud software tradition. Traditionally, if you create a web app that you want to share with other users, you host the app on your server, and the users connect to that. Blueprints are much more like mobile apps and traditional PC apps: every user runs their own copy of the software.

sentences.en: It may sound simple, but Blueprints are a major change from cloud software tradition.
sentences.zh: 听起来可能很简单，但蓝图是云软件传统的重大变化。

sentences.en: Traditionally, if you create a web app that you want to share with other users, you host the app on your server, and the users connect to that.
sentences.zh: 传统上，如果您创建一个想要与其他用户共享的 Web 应用程序，您可以将该应用程序托管在您的服务器上，然后用户连接到该应用程序。

sentences.en: Blueprints are much more like mobile apps and traditional PC apps: every user runs their own copy of the software.
sentences.zh: 蓝图更像移动应用程序和传统的 PC 应用程序：每个用户都运行自己的软件副本。

blocks.html_en: In the age of AI, this change is critically important. On one hand, AI empowers an individual developer to build more than ever, but it is still difficult for an individual developer to maintain an online service; this eliminates the need. On the other hand -- and even more importantly -- allowing each user to run their own copy of the software empowers the user to change the software to meet their needs, using AI. No need to file a feature request, no need to beg the developer to prioritize it. The end user can solve their own problems.

sentences.en: In the age of AI, this change is critically important.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能时代，这种变化至关重要。

sentences.en: On one hand, AI empowers an individual developer to build more than ever, but it is still difficult for an individual developer to maintain an online service; this eliminates the need.
sentences.zh: 一方面，人工智能使个人开发者能够构建比以往更多的东西，但个人开发者仍然很难维护在线服务；这就消除了需要。

sentences.en: On the other hand -- and even more importantly -- allowing each user to run their own copy of the software empowers the user to change the software to meet their needs, using AI.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，甚至更重要的是，允许每个用户运行自己的软件副本，使用户能够使用人工智能更改软件以满足自己的需求。

sentences.en: No need to file a feature request, no need to beg the developer to prioritize it.
sentences.zh: 无需提交功能请求，无需请求开发人员优先考虑它。

sentences.en: The end user can solve their own problems.
sentences.zh: 最终用户可以解决自己的问题。

blocks.html_en: Sandboxed and secure by default

sentences.en: Sandboxed and secure by default
sentences.zh: 默认情况下沙盒且安全

blocks.html_en: Each Gadget runs in a secure sandbox that prevents it from talking to the internet at all without your explicit consent. In particular:

sentences.en: Each Gadget runs in a secure sandbox that prevents it from talking to the internet at all without your explicit consent.
sentences.zh: 每个小工具都在安全沙箱中运行，未经您的明确同意，它根本无法与互联网通信。

sentences.en: In particular:
sentences.zh: 尤其：

blocks.html_en: • The server runs in a Dynamic Worker which has had its access to the internet disabled. It can only communicate with specific external resources that you have explicitly designated, via Workers Bindings.

sentences.en: The server runs in a Dynamic Worker which has had its access to the internet disabled.
sentences.zh: 服务器在动态工作线程中运行，该工作线程已禁用对互联网的访问。

sentences.en: It can only communicate with specific external resources that you have explicitly designated, via Workers Bindings.
sentences.zh: 它只能通过 Workers Bindings 与您明确指定的特定外部资源进行通信。

blocks.html_en: • The client code runs in a sandboxed iframe. This iframe can communicate with its server only via a Cap'n Web RPC session provided over postMessage() to the parent frame. The iframe is otherwise blocked from accessing the internet (to the maximum extent allowed by browsers, via Content-Security-Policy and iframe sandbox settings).

sentences.en: The client code runs in a sandboxed iframe.
sentences.zh: 客户端代码在沙盒 iframe 中运行。

sentences.en: This iframe can communicate with its server only via a Cap'n Web RPC session provided over postMessage() to the parent frame.
sentences.zh: 该 iframe 只能通过通过 postMessage() 向父框架提供的 Cap'n Web RPC 会话与其服务器进行通信。

sentences.en: The iframe is otherwise blocked from accessing the internet (to the maximum extent allowed by browsers, via Content-Security-Policy and iframe sandbox settings).
sentences.zh: 否则 iframe 将被阻止访问互联网（在浏览器允许的最大范围内，通过内容安全策略和 iframe 沙箱设置）。

blocks.html_en: Capability-based access control

sentences.en: Capability-based access control
sentences.zh: 基于能力的访问控制

blocks.html_en: Each agent, and each Gadget, by default has access to nothing. Even if you've configured the Gadget Workshop with access to external accounts, agents and Gadgets do NOT automatically get to use them.

sentences.en: Each agent, and each Gadget, by default has access to nothing.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，每个代理和每个小工具都无法访问任何内容。

sentences.en: Even if you've configured the Gadget Workshop with access to external accounts, agents and Gadgets do NOT automatically get to use them.
sentences.zh: 即使您已将小工具工作室配置为可以访问外部帐户，代理和小工具也不会自动使用它们。

blocks.html_en: Instead, you must introduce each agent (or Gadget) to any particular resources you want it to access. For instance, you may introduce a GitHub repository by pasting a link to it, or clicking "add resource" and selecting it via the UI. An agent can also request an introduction to a resource it thinks it needs, which you can then provide or deny.

sentences.en: Instead, you must introduce each agent (or Gadget) to any particular resources you want it to access.
sentences.zh: 相反，您必须向每个代理（或小工具）介绍您希望其访问的任何特定资源。

sentences.en: For instance, you may introduce a GitHub repository by pasting a link to it, or clicking "add resource" and selecting it via the UI.
sentences.zh: 例如，您可以通过粘贴链接来引入 GitHub 存储库，或者单击“添加资源”并通过 UI 选择它。

sentences.en: An agent can also request an introduction to a resource it thinks it needs, which you can then provide or deny.
sentences.zh: 代理还可以请求介绍其认为需要的资源，然后您可以提供或拒绝。

blocks.html_en: This differs from most agent harnesses, where MCP servers are configured upfront, making broad access to all your services ambiently available to the agent in every chat. Capability-based introductions keep each agent restricted to only the access it actually needs for the job at hand.

sentences.en: This differs from most agent harnesses, where MCP servers are configured upfront, making broad access to all your services ambiently available to the agent in every chat.

sentences.en: Capability-based introductions keep each agent restricted to only the access it actually needs for the job at hand.

content_html_zh:
Cloudflare OS：AI 生产力环境

Cloudflare OS 是一个用于提高 AI 生产力的“操作系统”，最初是为在 Cloudflare 内部使用而开发的。 Cloudflare 的很大一部分员工（从工程到销售以及介于两者之间的所有人员）每天都使用 Cloudflare OS 来帮助他们完成工作。

这不是传统的计算机操作系统。 我们在两种意义上使用“操作系统”一词：

  • 一个让公司能够以安全的方式利用人工智能提高工作效率的操作系统，这样安全团队就可以在晚上安然入睡。
  • 用于人工智能工作负载的操作系统，类似于传统操作系统管理计算工作负载的意义。

Cloudflare OS 特别提供了三件事：

  1. 客服人员聊天 UI，您可以在其中要求客服人员执行任务，并预装有关您公司运营方式的知识。
  2. 沙盒应用程序开发，以便您可以要求代理构建“小工具”（小型个人应用程序）并安全地与其他人共享您构建的内容。
  3. 一个名为“Gatekeepers”的安全框架，它将护栏应用于代理和应用程序，以便非技术用户可以安全地“发疯”，并且不会发生任何不好的事情。

我们正在将 Cloudflare OS 开源，以便其他人可以复制它并为自己的公司进行定制。 这个想法并不是让您的公司使用 Cloudflare 操作系统，而是让您将其设为“您公司的操作系统”。

快速入门

要在本地快速运行 Cloudflare OS，请安装 pnpm，然后执行以下操作：

pnpm run-local

然后访问：http://localhost:8787

这会在 wrangler 和 workerd 上本地运行整个堆栈。 这并不适合生产用途，而是一种了解产品功能的快速方法。

或者，您可以部署到您的 Cloudflare 帐户。

（本自述文件末尾有更多选项。）

尝试什么

尝试如下提示：

  • “为我即将与客户举行的会议制作幻灯片。” （这将使用内置的幻灯片蓝图。）
  • “制作一个协作白板应用程序。” （这将从头开始创建一个新的应用程序。）
  • “制作一个井字游戏。” 接下来是“我是 X，你是 O。 我已经迈出了第一步。 轮到你了。”
  • “为此 GitHub 存储库制作一个问题仪表板。” （附加存储库；需要配置 GitHub 集成。）
  • “修正此 Google 文档中的拼写错误。” （附加文档；需要配置 Google 集成。）

警告：抢先体验

Cloudflare OS 正处于大力开发状态。 该存储库实际上是版本 2，完全重写了我们从版本 1 中学到的知识，并将其置于新的基础上。

截至 2026 年 8 月发布，Cloudflare OS v2 功能非常强大，但仍然存在许多缺陷。 我们知道，并且我们正在努力。 目前，请将此视为“抢先体验”版本。

概述：Cloudflare OS 到底是什么？

小工具：一种思考软件的新方式

Cloudflare OS 不仅仅是另一个带有连接器的聊天框。 该系统围绕一种新的软件方法展开，每个用户都运行自己使用的生产力应用程序的副本。

当您在 Cloudflare OS 中创建幻灯片时，您并不是调用在云中运行的某些 SaaS 软件。 系统专为您创建幻灯片软件的私有实例。 我们称之为“小工具”。 该实例在与其他人的幻灯片不同的单独沙箱中运行。

这有两个深远的影响：

  1. 幻灯片应用程序不可能存在将幻灯片泄露给攻击者的安全错误。 Cloudflare OS 沙箱控制对应用程序私有实例的所有访问。
  2. 如果你愿意，你可以自由修改代码。 如果幻灯片应用程序缺少您需要的功能，您可以要求您的代理添加它。 由于第一点，这样做是完全安全的。

这与过去 25 年的云架构和“软件即服务”有很大的不同，但我们认为人工智能已经改变了这个方程式。 当任何用户能够提示代理添加他们需要的功能时，集中式软件模型就不再有意义。

看门人：基于能力的安全层

网守就像增压的 MCP 服务器。

当您将代理或小工具引入外部资源时，将创建一个网守来管理该访问。 Gatekeeper 是特定于每个外部服务的软件，它调节小工具与该服务的连接。 它：

  • 为服务提供干净的 Cap'n Web API（包装服务本机提供的任何 API）。
  • 处理授权（例如通过 OAuth）。
  • 强制仅访问用户想要的特定资源。
  • 记录小工具（或代理）执行的每个操作，以供您查看。
  • 对于任何具有副作用的操作，为人类用户提供批准或拒绝该操作的机会（“人在循环中”）。

关于最后一点，Gatekeepers 在现有技术中实现了重大进步。 传统上，人机交互设置要求人类同步批准操作。 当代理想要做某事时，它必须停下来等待批准才能继续。 这很烦人：你给你的代理一项任务，然后走开去喝杯咖啡，结果回来时发现代理在第一步的批准上陷入困境，没有取得任何进展。 结果，人们经常屈服并将他们的代理设置为“自动批准”，或者危险地跳过权限，这显然是不安全的。

Gatekeeper 提供了一种更好的方法：当代理（或 Gadget）执行需要批准的操作时，Gatekeeper 将在本地模拟结果，允许代理继续并排队更多操作。 Gatekeeper 告诉代理操作已完成，如果代理尝试读回结果，Gatekeeper 会向其提供模拟结果。 代理完成后，用户可以批量或逐一批准或拒绝操作，但无论哪种方式，他们都可以在以后方便的时候执行。

从逻辑上讲，每个 Gatekeeper 都是作为一个单独的 Worker 来实现的。 未来，我们设想 Gatekeeper 服务将独立于操作系统实例进行部署和维护，但细节尚未确定。 目前，我们在此存储库中提供了一些有趣的 Gatekeeper，您可以将它们与您自己的操作系统实例一起部署。

考虑一套办公套件

Cloudflare OS 的基本用户体验类似于在线办公套件，例如 Google Docs 或 MS Office。 但是，想象一下，每个文件（或“小工具”）不是一组固定的文件类型（文档、电子表格、幻灯片），而是可能有自己的自定义应用程序，由人工智能编写，以满足您的需求。

就像 Office 文档一样，每个小工具默认都是私有的，但可以安全地共享，以便与您的团队或朋友协作。

就像办公室文档一样，您可以拥有数千个文档。 您可以随心所欲地创建它们。

就像办公室文档一样，您可以从“模板”开始——称为“蓝图”。 但是，办公模板只是一些内容，而蓝图指定了整个应用程序。

与 Office 文档一样，您可以从自己的文档（小工具）创建新模板（蓝图）并与其他人共享。 但当您这样做时，您正在共享整个应用程序的代码。

它有点像一个操作系统

操作系统术语并不完全是营销术语。 Cloudflare OS 实际上类似于技术层面上的操作系统。

正常操作系统 Cloudflare操作系统
核心 包/研讨会后端
设备驱动程序 包/看门人-*
shell 包/研讨会前端
流程 小玩意
可执行文件 蓝图
users users
ACLs 共享权限
??? 代理人

我们的“内核”位于 Workshop-backend 包中。 后端合法地执行许多类似于真实操作系统内核的操作：它将用户连接到程序和设备（我们称之为小工具和网守），同时通过沙箱应用程序和实施访问控制来实现安全性。

在这个类比中，网守（将用户和代理连接到外部服务）就像驱动程序（将用户和程序连接到外部设备）。

如今，传统操作系统无法真正管理一件事，但 Cloudflare OS 可以管理：AI 代理。 如果你仔细想想，这确实是传统操作系统所缺少的功能。 我们认为人工智能代理不能简单地被视为用户。 他们必须对人类用户负责，同时拥有自己的受限权限。 代理通过编写代码片段并即时执行来工作。 所有这一切的理想安全模型是基于功能的安全性，而不是访问控制列表。 明白我的意思吗？ 也许传统操作系统也应该给予人工智能代理特殊待遇。

由 Workers 团队以 Workers 为基础构建

Cloudflare OS 构建于 Cloudflare Workers 之上，特别大量使用了 Durable Objects、Dynamic Workers 和 Facets。 每个工作区都是其自己的持久对象，每个小工具都在动态工作人员方面运行，并且网守还将方面安装到每个工作区中以管理对远程服务的访问。

事实上，Cloudflare OS 是由构建 Workers 的人构建的。 它使用了 Workers Runtime 的尖端功能——事实上，动态 Workers、Facets 和其他几个功能都被添加到运行时中，专门用于支持 Cloudflare OS，而且还会有更多功能。 研究 Cloudflare OS 源代码是了解 Workers Runtime 团队认为应如何使用 Workers 的好方法。

基于 Workers 构建并不意味着 Cloudflare OS 只能在 Cloudflare 上运行。 事实上，workerd（Cloudflare Workers Runtime）本身就是开源的，Cloudflare OS 可以完全在您自己的服务器上运行。

特征

通用多用途剂

Cloudflare OS 编码代理实际上是一个完全多用途的代理，可以执行任意任务；与其他流行的编码代理一样，您不必使用它进行编码。 您可以使用它来构建 Gadget，但您也可以跳过 Gadget，直接让代理执行任务。 Cloudflare OS 代理是一种代码模式代理 - 它通过编写并立即执行代码片段来执行任务。 它可以使用网守（如 MCP - 见下文）连接到外部资源。

使用 AI 构建应用程序

虽然您可以根据需要手动编写小工具代码，但我们期望 AI 为您编写代码。 Cloudflare OS 具有内置编码代理，可以构建您要求的任何内容、为您测试并调试错误。

您可以选择您的 LLM。 Cloudflare OS 与许多主要的 AI 模型提供商和自托管模型合作，并且一直在添加更多提供商。

由于平台的紧密集成和简化特性，即使使用相同的底层 AI 模型，Cloudflare OS 编码代理通常也能比通用编码代理以更少的令牌执行更好、更快的性能。

与人工智能合作

每个使用 Cloudflare OS 构建的应用程序都会自动具有代理友好的 API。 这意味着，在您要求 AI 构建应用程序后，您还可以要求 AI 在应用程序内与您协作。 无需构建 MCP 服务器，也无需集成自定义代理循环。 它只是默认存在。

这是可行的，因为 Gadget 的客户端和服务器部分需要通过 Cap'n Web RPC 进行通信。 这是双赢的：

  1. Cap'n Web 的样板代码极少，这使得代理可以轻松使用。 您基本上只需在服务器上定义一个方法，然后从客户端调用它，就像本地调用一样。
  2. 同时，这意味着服务器必须公开一个易于理解的API，可以由代理直接调用。 AI Agent 工具使用代码模式进行工具调用，因此可以轻松直接公开 Gadget 的 API 以供代理调用。

实时多人游戏

您可以共享您的小工具，就像在典型的在线办公套件中共享文档一样。 您可以授予特定用户访问权限，或创建共享链接，为打开该链接的任何人提供访问权限。 就像那些在线办公套件一样，您将能够实时查看协作者的操作。

这是有效的，因为每个 Gadget 都由持久对象（Durable Object）支持，这是 Cloudflare 的有状态无服务器原语，使实时多人协作变得容易。 它非常简单，编码代理只需默认实现即可，无需询问。

蓝图：分享您的代码

如果您创建了一个可能对其他人有用的小工具，但您不想共享该小工具本身，则可以共享蓝图，从而允许其他人创建自己的小工具副本。 蓝图本质上是代码的副本。

听起来可能很简单，但蓝图是云软件传统的重大变化。 传统上，如果您创建一个想要与其他用户共享的 Web 应用程序，您可以将该应用程序托管在您的服务器上，然后用户连接到该应用程序。 蓝图更像移动应用程序和传统的 PC 应用程序：每个用户都运行自己的软件副本。

在人工智能时代，这种变化至关重要。 一方面，人工智能使个人开发者能够构建比以往更多的东西，但个人开发者仍然很难维护在线服务；这就消除了需要。 另一方面，甚至更重要的是，允许每个用户运行自己的软件副本，使用户能够使用人工智能更改软件以满足自己的需求。 无需提交功能请求，无需请求开发人员优先考虑它。 最终用户可以解决自己的问题。

默认情况下沙盒且安全

每个小工具都在安全沙箱中运行，未经您的明确同意，它根本无法与互联网通信。 尤其：

  • 服务器在动态工作线程中运行，该工作线程已禁用对互联网的访问。 它只能通过 Workers Bindings 与您明确指定的特定外部资源进行通信。
  • 客户端代码在沙盒 iframe 中运行。 该 iframe 只能通过通过 postMessage() 向父框架提供的 Cap'n Web RPC 会话与其服务器进行通信。 否则 iframe 将被阻止访问互联网（在浏览器允许的最大范围内，通过内容安全策略和 iframe 沙箱设置）。

基于能力的访问控制

默认情况下，每个代理和每个小工具都无法访问任何内容。 即使您已将小工具工作室配置为可以访问外部帐户，代理和小工具也不会自动使用它们。

相反，您必须向每个代理（或小工具）介绍您希望其访问的任何特定资源。 例如，您可以通过粘贴链接来引入 GitHub 存储库，或者单击“添加资源”并通过 UI 选择它。 代理还可以请求介绍其认为需要的资源，然后您可以提供或拒绝。

这与大多数代理工具不同，在大多数代理工具中，MCP 服务器是预先配置的，使代理可以在每次聊天中广泛访问所有服务。 基于能力的介绍使每个代理仅限于手头工作实际需要的访问权限。

开始使用

部署到您的 Cloudflare 帐户

我们构建了一个在线流程，可帮助您部署到您自己的 Cloudflare 帐户：

https://os.cloudflare.app/deploy

或者，对于更复杂的部署，以及您的网守和潜在的代码更改，请查看我们的部署入门存储库：

https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-os-starter

本地运行

要在本地快速运行 Cloudflare OS，请安装 pnpm，然后执行以下操作：

pnpm run-local

然后访问：http://localhost:8787

这使用 wrangler（Workers 开发人员工具 CLI）运行 Cloudflare OS。 这不是在生产服务器上运行操作系统的正确方法，但在本地计算机上尝试它效果很好。

您的数据将存储在名为 .wrangler 的子目录中。

使用workerd部署到您自己的服务器

即将推出

Cloudflare OS 可以完全在workerd 上运行，workerd 是Cloudflare 的Workers 开源运行时。 事实上，上面的“本地运行”指令在幕后使用了workerd。 我们仍在开发文档和工具，以帮助您在自己的服务器上的workerd 之上顺利部署操作系统。 如果您喜欢冒险，请阅读workerd配置的低级文档（或将您的代理指向它）并尝试一下。

配置外部服务

许多 Gatekeeper 需要进行配置才能连接到第三方服务，包括获取每个服务的 OAuth 客户端凭据。 不幸的是，许多服务提供商故意不让这变得容易，因为 OAuth 的目标受众是开发人员。

每个网守包都包含有关如何设置它的说明：

发展

开发时，您需要在两个终端中将前端和后端作为两个单独的命令运行：

pnpm dev-server
pnpm dev-client

然后访问：http://localhost:3000

贡献

目前，我们并不寻求外部贡献。

人工智能使编写代码变得容易。 今天，最困难的部分不是编写代码，而是对其进行审查，确保保持高质量并保持产品的连贯性。 从这个角度来看，不幸的是，外部代码贡献正在“捐赠”工作中容易的部分，同时创造了更多的艰苦工作。

话虽如此，我们很乐意接受经过简单验证的小型 PR 来解决问题。 但是，我们要求您不要提交低价值的 PR（例如拼写错误修复）或超过十几行的 PR。 此类 PR 将参考本指南结束。

如果您有一个伟大的想法希望我们考虑，请随时展开讨论。

随着项目的成熟，这一政策将来可能会发生变化。 在此之前，感谢您的理解。
